hotel_name: Blue Sapphire Motel & Resort By Devam

positive_snippets: Blue Sapphire Hotel & Banquet is one of the finest luxury wedding venues in Delhi. The ambience feels elegant and well-maintained, and the halls are spacious with beautiful décor that gives any event a premium and grand experience. The staff is professional and attentive, ensuring that guests are well taken care of. The food quality is impressive, and their catering service is one of the highlights. Parking space is also sufficient for large gatherings. Overall, if you are planning a luxury wedding or a grand celebration in Delhi, this venue is definitely worth considering.

The motel impressed us with its splendid decor, setting a high standard for ambiance. The service exceeded expectations, delivering top-notch hospitality.

The motel's location was also easy to locate and with ample parking space.

Overall, our experience was positive, marked by memorable moments captured in photographs. The aesthetic appeal of the motel provided an excellent backdrop for creating lasting memories.

The overall atmosphere and service contributed to a satisfying experience. Each corner of the motel offered a picturesque setting, allowing us to capture beautiful images. From the lobby to the rooms, the attention to detail in the decor enhanced our enjoyment. The motel's other attributes also ensured a fulfilling experience. In the end, it was a successful stay, leaving us with fond memories and stunning photographs.
Everything was Good! May it was the food, services, cleanliness. The only drawback is the approach road to the resort while traveling from Delhi side otherwise a Good Option to have family functions
